reading.title: Void Moon Under Scorpio Sun Square Pluto
overview: The Sun at 6° Scorpio and Mercury retrograde at 19° Scorpio square Mars at 17° Leo while the Moon at 25° Gemini runs void of course until 30 October. Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde remains sextile Pluto at 3° Aquarius out of bounds, and Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto. These slow outer contacts continue their long-term reconfiguration of collective assumptions and power structures.

Venus at 27° Libra retrograde in rulership sextiles Jupiter at 24° Leo while squaring Pluto, and Saturn at 9° Aries retrograde stays in fall. The last New Moon at Libra 17° fell in the eleventh house for the United States and the sixth for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, placing emphasis on legislatures and allies or on armed forces and public health according to each capital.

Mundane tradition reads the Neptune-Pluto sextile as gradual shifts in what societies accept as real, the Mercury-Mars square as sharp exchanges and information pressure, and the Sun-Pluto square as tests of authority. The void Moon advises against expecting decisive movement until it enters Cancer.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while the Sun trines natal Jupiter. These contacts coincide with reported economic data and midterm focus, yet the fair-test records show no reliable link between such Neptune transits and measurable national outcomes.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Uranus trines natal Saturn. Today's reporting of drone strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure sits with the Mercury-Mars square, while the chart itself supplies no predictive edge beyond chance.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Mars squares natal Pluto. The sixth-house New Moon placement and current transits align with ongoing armed-forces themes in the supplied intelligence, though records find no statistical improvement over random expectation.
Pluto conjoins the natal Moon and ASC while Saturn opposes the natal Sun. These contacts remain wide of immediate daily events in the given material.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto overlap with reporting on AI drones and Brazilian political claims; Mercury square Mars overlaps with accounts of the Dnipro station attack and Hormuz tanker claims. Venus square Pluto touches coverage of Black Sea shipping risks. No overlap appears with the Bolsonaro or Sudanese items, and the fair-test results show none of the cited aspects or lunar phases improve on chance for the tracked events.

watch.note: New Moon at Scorpio 17°; watch for fresh starts in Scorpio-ruled matters.
Mercury and Venus both station direct; note any clarification or resumption in stalled negotiations or markets.
Full Moon at Gemini 2°; observe outcomes tied to the prior New Moon houses.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, retrogrades, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance for Ukraine alarms, Israeli alerts, Russian losses or global magnitude-6+ quakes. The listed lunar and planetary claims therefore carry no demonstrated predictive value.
